description.value: Heart & Bone Provisions is a health-focused café and provisions shop in Ganges on Salt Spring Island, specializing in premium bone broth made from organic, free-range ingredients with a keto-oriented menu. Cyclists can pick up take-home items from a self-serve cooler and freezer stocked with frozen broth, soups, eggs, butter, and low-sugar sweet treats, or dine in for a nourishing meal. The shop also offers online ordering with pickup and delivery, making it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists on the island.
